roles.background: Boolean circuit complexity, graph/discrete complexity, fusion-method lower bounds
roles.assessment: The least fixed-point semi-filter closure is source-native and exactly aligned with unrestricted preservation, unlike the first-order G_NEQ signature state.
roles.strongest_objection: Exact representation alone says nothing about super-log lower bounds; the entire problem is now an accounting theorem that connects closure state to one-fusion cost.
roles.recommended_falsifier: attack O(1) marginal sensitivity before target-family search

roles.background: finite closure systems, implicational/Horn systems, extremal set systems
roles.assessment: The closure is naturally a monotone Horn-style least fixed point. Latent rules can cascade after one new rule creates a missing antecedent.
roles.strongest_objection: Raw closure cardinality is especially suspect because one small derived intersection adds all of its supersets; derivation depth and new-intersection count can also cascade.
roles.recommended_falsifier: construct an explicit family D_1,...,D_m and dormant old pairs where adding one pair (D_1,D_2) produces C_2, then C_3,...,C_m=empty

roles.background: counterexample-first lower bounds, integrality gaps, hard-vs-easy target separation
roles.assessment: A generic cascade example is high information because it can kill a whole class of naive potentials at negligible cost.
roles.strongest_objection: A generic discrete-space construction may not be realizable by row/column traces of a graph. It cannot block graph-specific closure charges.
roles.recommended_falsifier: scope the proposition to source-compatible finite discrete spaces; then separately ask whether graph geometry suppresses the cascade

roles.background: statement binding, executable finite checks, chronology and assurance
roles.assessment: Chronology is clean so far: child context then memory were committed before any C026 candidate. A candidate may be proposed only after this review and a hash-chained NEXT_STEP_PROPOSED trace are frozen.
roles.strongest_objection: Do not label a finite program as proof of an all-m proposition. The general family needs a symbolic derivation; code is regression/calibration only.
roles.recommended_falsifier: state the construction parametrically and test small m as an implementation check

roles.background: complexity-theory prior-art triage and method-transfer assessment
roles.assessment: The forward-chaining observation is elementary and should not be sold as a new mathematical theorem. Its value is route pruning inside this exact research programme.
roles.strongest_objection: Calling Horn-cascade sensitivity novel would overclaim known closure-system behavior.
roles.recommended_falsifier: make no novelty claim; record only a source-bound application-specific obstruction to raw closure-growth metrics

roles.background: agentic research telemetry, causal attribution, fail-closed research-process evaluation
evidence_inspected: Paper-5 metrology requirements in automation prompt
roles.assessment: The cycle should count one retained obstruction/representation relation if the cascade is proved, but must not count commits/files as learning.
roles.strongest_objection: The pre/post v3 state cannot be faithfully materialized from repository artifacts in this connector-only run, so state fingerprints must be CANNOT_MEASURE rather than guessed.
roles.recommended_falsifier: record exact Git subjects, retrieved IDs, process surfaces, and novelty axes; leave token/time/state fields unavailable when not observable

disagreements: The closure-systems lead views the cascade proposition as structurally generic; the adversarial lead insists that its negative authority stop at generic finite discrete spaces until a graph-generator realization is shown.
The complexity lead considers source-native closure the right representation; the adversarial lead stresses that representation adequacy and lower-bound accounting remain separate.
strongest_shared_objection: A rich exact closure state can still be useless for lower bounds if one legal pair has unbounded marginal effect through dormant-rule cascades.

recommendation.next_action: Freeze NEXT_STEP_PROPOSED, then propose C026 as a narrowly scoped cascade obstruction. Prove a parametric generic discrete-space construction and run small-m regression. If it passes, reject raw closure cardinality, raw derived-intersection count, and raw propagation depth as universally O(1)-per-fusion potentials. Do not reject source-native closure itself; reopen accounting/quotient search and separately test graph-specific suppression.
